expect: Generally hot and dry. Harmattan dust and dry air can affect visibility and comfort, especially in northern Ghana.
Hot conditions continue. The north is usually very dry; southern areas may feel humid.
Hot weather continues. The first rains may begin in parts of southern Ghana.

season: Main rainy season begins in the south
expect: Rainfall becomes more frequent in many southern areas. Expect warm, humid conditions.

season: Rainy season in much of the south
expect: Showers and thunderstorms are common in southern Ghana. Northern areas may still be comparatively dry.
Often wet in southern Ghana. Some roads and trails may become muddy or difficult to use.

season: Mid-year rains and relative break in parts of the south
expect: Rainfall patterns vary. Coastal and southern areas can be cloudy and humid; northern areas may be entering their rainy season.

season: Variable; often cooler on the coast
expect: Southern coastal areas may experience a relatively cooler, cloudy period. Northern Ghana is generally in its rainy season.

season: Second rainy period in parts of the south
expect: Rain may increase again in parts of southern Ghana. Northern areas can remain wet.

season: Rainy season easing in the south
expect: Rainfall often begins to reduce in southern Ghana, though local conditions differ.

season: Dry season begins in many southern areas
expect: Generally becoming drier and sunnier. Harmattan may begin later in the month or in some years later.
Usually hot and dry, with possible Harmattan haze, dust and cooler nights in some areas.
